audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty read 6/10 and the final rating called it 'Even' on a 47.1% lane over 4,792 games, and the first five chart rows credited Riven or Skill while their own why-text says Garen wins each of them.
audit.why: The mirror (garen__riven) settled this as Garen 6/10 through Level 6 and Riven 4/10 from first item on. Riven's page must state the same rows with inverse ratings. 47.1% is a losing lane, not an even one.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 flipped to Garen at 4/10; rows 5-6 stay Riven and move to 6/10. diffRating raised to 7.5/10 with breakdown.difficulty following.

audit.whatIsWrong: Garen's carry threat was rated 7/10; the mirror settled it at 8/10.
audit.why: Both pages have to publish the same threat number, and 8/10 matches a Garen who wins the first six levels of this lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's defect is exact: the entry never named a single Garen ability. Demacian Justice's true damage was never mentioned, Courage's tenacity was never mentioned, and Decisive Strike's auto-attack reset was never mentioned.
audit.why: Courage grants tenacity as well as a shield (Riot's own text), which shortens Riven's Ki Burst stun on top of cutting the burst — that is why committing into a fresh W fails. Demacian Justice is true-damage execute, so no amount of armour changes the threshold. Decisive Strike is an auto reset, so the wind-up animation is the tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Perseverance, Decisive Strike (8s), Courage and Demacian Justice (120/100/80) all named and their real mechanics stated in whys[3], whys[4], wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracks Courage as the matchup-defining cooldown but never gives a number for either Courage or Decisive Strike.
audit.why: Decisive Strike is a flat 8 seconds at every rank — the tightest and most punishable window in the lane. Courage is 22s at rank 1 down to 12s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now states the 8-second Decisive Strike cycle; the Courage number is recorded here for a follow-up pass that can edit the mojibake-carrying full-layer strings.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Courage and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you dodge Decisive Strike's silence and stay disciplined.

edits.before: Carry threat: 7/10. If Garen gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.
edits.after: Carry threat: 8/10. If Garen gets ahead, shift from winning trades to wave control, vision, and jungle play.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 he cycles Q silence repeatedly and his passive regen between your cooldowns means every short trade is his — you cannot out-sustain the regen pattern.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 he cycles Decisive Strike every 8s and Perseverance refills him between your cooldowns, so short trades are all his — force long ones or none.

edits.before: His Q silence and W are both up for every fight and he hits his own item ramp — you cannot convert the pattern without baiting both cooldowns first.
edits.after: Demacian Justice executes with true damage, so armour is no answer — stay above his threshold, and do not start a fight already low on his 120s rank-1 R.

edits.before: Bait out Garen's W before committing your W stun so your burst isn't halved by his damage reduction
edits.after: Bait Courage first — it gives tenacity and a shield, so your Ki Burst stun is short and your burst halved

edits.before: Silence your Q-chain mid-cast with Q to break your combo and strip your passive charges
edits.after: Open with Decisive Strike's auto reset to silence your Q-chain and strip your charges
